source: Formula-derived (upstream kw/lyric.rs and kw/crypto.rs ship no tests and no golden ciphertext): params XORed with the cyclic 'yeelion' key then base64-encoded; recomputed and round-trip verified with Python (2026-11-18 slice re-verification: both cases MATCH). The plain case pins the plain lyric request; the lrcx case pins the word-lyric request (params + '&lrcx=1') sent by fetch_raw_lyric(_, true).
